captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a realistic camera lens with a matte black cylindrical barrel, featuring a prominent orange accent ring near the front element. The barrel is divided into two main control rings (focus and zoom) detailed with white tick marks and ribbed textures for grip. The base of the lens includes small grey rectangular mounting tabs, and the entire assembly is designed to simulate a precision optical device with rotating rings.
captions.instruction: Generate a realistic, highly detailed camera lens with a matte black barrel, an orange accent ring, and ribbed control rings. The focus and zoom rings should be modeled as separate parts with revolute joints to allow realistic rotational articulation, complete with white indicator ticks and mounting tabs at the base.
captions.factory: Construct the camera lens by building the main body using concentric cylinders, chamfered edges, and boolean subtraction for the hollow lens cavity. Create the ribbed focus and zoom control rings as separate parts, detailing them with small rectangular polar arrays for the white indicator ticks and the grip ribs. Add the orange accent ring as a thin torus or cylinder, and attach grey rectangular tabs at the base to represent the lens mount. Define continuous or revolute joints between the main barrel and the focus/zoom rings to enable realistic rotation.
